title: larecomp.exe --describe (LAUNCHER-FOLLOWS-GAME section 5.1)
description: What larecomp.exe prints on stdout for --describe (exit 0, no window, no game data): the contracts this exe speaks and the batch actions it has, so a launcher can tell an old game from a new one without opening a file. The install manifest carries the same contracts object.

contracts.description: the version of each contract this exe speaks: settings_ui, machine, install_manifest, ...
